m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Hello there! An order from Ogden Peake? Righto!
You’d best get that to Ogden’s house in Regent’s Square, in Marleybone! He’s in the brownstone with the pawprint over the door.
Did you deliver the present? I hope Arrow was a good little dog!
You’ve been so helpful! I wonder if I might impose again, however... in exchange for a point for your training, of course!
I made arrangements for my house-sitter to take care of my dog, Arrow, while I was away, but I fear he might be lonely still.
I promised Arrow a little play-thing when I returned... nice little collar for it to wear!
It’s been so long since I left, and I’d like to do something nice for my doggie until I get back.
Could you visit the Pet Shoppe Boys in Wizard City, pick up the collar, and deliver it to my house in Marleybone?
Could you pick up my order from the Pet Shoppe Boys in Wizard City, and deliver it to my house in Marleybone?
